title: CuriousTogether: Implications of Curiosity and Cultural Grounding in Multi-Agent LLM Interactions
abstract: arXiv:2611.01301v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in multi-agent settings, exhibiting emergent collective behaviors, yet the role of curiosity as a driver of such dynamics remains understudied. We introduce CuriousTogether, a framework evaluating curiosity-driven multi-agent LLM interactions across three complementary dimensions: novelty-seeking, epistemic and social curiosity. Across eight tasks spanning reasoning, creative generation, and social bias mitigation, curiosity-guided multi-agent settings yield improvements over non-curious ones on seven out of eight tasks, with gains of up to 20.6% in story generation (semantic diversity) and a 14.9 pp reduction in stereotype rates. Furthermore, country-conditioned cultural grounding show benefits for story generation and social tasks, but can hurt precision-oriented reasoning. translated_title: CuriousTogether：好奇心与文化背景在多智能体大语言模型交互中的影响
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被部署在多智能体环境中，展现出涌现的集体行为，然而好奇心作为这种动态的驱动因素所起的作用仍未得到充分研究。我们提出了CuriousTogether，一个从三个互补维度评估好奇心驱动的多智能体大语言模型交互的框架：新颖性寻求、认知性好奇心和社会性好奇心。在涵盖推理、创意生成和社会偏见缓解的八项任务中，好奇心引导的多智能体设置在八项任务中的七项上优于非好奇心设置，其中故事生成（语义多样性）的增益高达20.6%，刻板印象率降低了14.9个百分点。此外，以国家为条件的文化背景设定对故事生成和社会类任务有益，但可能损害面向精确性的推理。最后，我们表明推理时基于好奇心的多智能体方法提供了有利的质量-标记（token）权衡。
tldr: 提出CuriousTogether框架，证明好奇心驱动的多智能体LLM交互在八项任务中的七项上优于非好奇心设置，故事生成语义多样性提升最高达20.6%、刻板印象率降低14.9个百分点，且文化背景设定有利于创意和社会任务但可能损害精确推理。
en_tdlr: CuriousTogether demonstrates that curiosity-driven multi-agent LLM interactions outperform non-curious settings on 7 of 8 tasks, with up to 20.6% gains in semantic diversity and a 14.9 pp reduction in stereotype rates, while cultural grounding benefits creative and social tasks but can hurt precision-oriented reasoning.
